mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing prednisolone metabolism inhibition and elevating corticosteroid levels, while prednisolone may increase clarithromycin clearance via enzyme induction at higher doses.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression); consider dose adjustment of prednisolone or alternative antibiotic if prolonged clarithromycin therapy required.
